references.text: The five men were sent out from Zorah and Eshtaol to spy out the land, and now they are returning to their brothers in those same cities.
The Spirit of the Lord began to stir Samson in Mahaneh-Dan, between Zorah and Eshtaol, the same cities mentioned here.
The spies that Moses sent out returned and gave a report to the people about the land they had explored, in a similar way as these spies are reporting to their brothers.
Joshua's spies returned and reported on Jericho, just as these men are reporting back to their brothers.
Six hundred armed men set out from Zorah and Eshtaol, as a result of the spies' report to the brothers.
